# tone event is unpitched

True when this ToneEvent has no definite pitch (e.g. percussion, noise). Mutually exclusive with toneEventPitchValue and toneEventPitchTrajectory.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/toneEventIsUnpitched>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:toneEventIsUnpitched`  

*datatype property* · domain `gmeow:ToneEvent` · range `xsd:boolean` · functional
